name: Analog-horror PSA short
summary: Golden set for a stenciled-pictogram / robo-broadcast / VHS-aesthetic PSA short: locked yellow-on-black civil-defense look, keyed transparent icons, robo-PSA voice, and a grain stack that keeps blacks black vs. the milky-floor, boxed-icon, and reused-code failures.

examples.label: good
features: Locked 1970s civil-defense look: yellow-on-black stenciled pictograms, IF / DO-NOT / BUT / AND scenario structure
Icons are keyed to true transparency (luma alpha) before compositing, so screen-blend layers show no residual box
Blacks stay black: grain applied as low-opacity overlay-blend, not screen-blend that washes the floor milky
Robo-PSA voice: ALL-CAPS input, Alerter-style voice, stability ~0.5, style 0 — flat broadcast-bulletin cadence
A NEW unique bulletin/alert code for this PSA (never a reused code from a sibling in the series)
Layered VHS-noise + chromatic-split + a SMPTE colour-bars climax; final encode -tune grain at CRF 30
examples.notes: Validated on analog-horror-mirror-001. The analog-horror-psa skill owns the full recipe.

examples.label: acceptable
features: Look and voice on-register and blacks held, but the chromatic-split is faint enough to read as a clean caption
Unique alert code present but the VHS-tracking bands are static rather than wandering
Climax present but the colour-bars blur is slightly under the mandated amount
examples.notes: Ships; the flat-caption flicker + static tracking are the cheap next-pass wins.

examples.label: bad
features: Milky grey floor: grain applied via screen-blend overexposes the blacks (the #1 register breaker)
Keyed icons show a lighter rectangle box because colorkey was used instead of luma-alpha under screen-blend layers
Reused the SAME alert/bulletin code as another PSA in the series (breaks the in-universe continuity)
Friendly / conversational VO instead of the flat robo-bulletin cadence (kills the dread)
CSS @keyframes used for caption flicker — not seek-captured by the HF renderer, so it renders static / wrong
examples.notes: Each failure maps to a logged postmortem fix: keep-blacks-black (overlay grain), luma-key icons, unique code per PSA, GSAP-driven flicker (not CSS @keyframes).
